surfaces.name: Vercel Static Web Frontend
surfaces.role: Public HQ, game, studio, world, safety, payload, master-interface, and integration pages.
surfaces.activation: Already deploys as static HTML on Vercel. Live interface updating is enabled for safe preview UI state without external writes.

surfaces.name: Flutter App Layer
surfaces.role: Future mobile shells for splash, world home, Lingo ID, profile, XP, virtual wallet display, store previews, notifications surface, and settings.
surfaces.activation: Add mobile runtime contracts only after auth, consent, no-cash-out enforcement, and app-store review language exist.

surfaces.name: Firebase Optional App Services
surfaces.role: Optional Auth, App Check, Firestore, Cloud Storage, FCM, Crashlytics, Analytics, and Remote Config.
surfaces.activation: Do not enable Cloud Functions, Firestore writes, app telemetry, or Firebase Storage from this static repo without a separate backend plan.

surfaces.name: Cloudflare DNS and Edge Boundary
surfaces.role: Optional DNS, redirect, cache, bot/security, or edge boundary in front of Vercel-owned deployments.
surfaces.activation: Keep Vercel as deployment source of truth; DNS and edge changes require domain-specific verification before edits.

surfaces.name: Vercel Delivery Layer
surfaces.role: Static hosting, deployments, previews, domains, headers, aliases, and Vercel Blob for file storage.
surfaces.activation: No new Functions are active in this blueprint.

surfaces.name: GitHub Source and PR Layer
surfaces.role: Source control, pull requests, validation workflow, review, and Vercel deployment trigger source.
surfaces.activation: Use focused PRs; avoid broad auto-build loops.

surfaces.name: Vercel Blob File Storage
surfaces.role: First-party file storage for images, documents, generated assets, profile uploads, and media.
surfaces.activation: Use immutable blob URLs and separate pointers for mutable content.

surfaces.name: Neon Relational Storage via Vercel Marketplace
surfaces.role: Future relational data for users, entitlements, audit logs, configs, purchases, and economy state.
surfaces.activation: Vercel Postgres is no longer first-party; existing databases migrated to Neon via Vercel Marketplace in December 2024.

surfaces.name: Upstash Redis Cache via Vercel Marketplace
surfaces.role: Future cache, rate counters, idempotency keys, queues, and AI flavor dedupe.
surfaces.activation: Vercel KV is no longer first-party; existing stores migrated to Upstash Redis via Vercel Marketplace in December 2024.

appDimensions.flutter: future mobile app screens and contracts
appDimensions.firebase: optional app services after protected activation
appDimensions.cloudflare: optional DNS/edge boundary after domain verification
appDimensions.vercel: deployment, domains, previews, static hosting, Blob
appDimensions.liveInterfaceUpdating: enabled for static preview UI refresh state
